scope: Current US ECE-affiliated faculty, including official courtesy and joint appointments and announced incoming professors
unit_authority: Official university EE/ECE faculty designation or explicit EE/ECE appointment
incoming_rule: Include officially announced incoming EE/ECE professors in the included appointment categories, preserving incoming status and the announced start date when known. Excluded appointment types remain excluded.
source_precedence: Specific official appointment type or effective-date information disambiguates a generic roster title.
Official designated EE/ECE roster or EE track establishes membership in a combined department.

A specific official appointment type or future-start designation takes precedence over an undated generic biography. Courtesy qualifies under this policy; other excluded appointment types remain excluded.
Conflicting equally specific official claims remain unresolved until reviewed.
Personal sites, ORCID, and bibliographic records corroborate individual claims and reveal omissions; they do not independently override official EE/ECE membership.
joint_appointments: An explicit professorial EE/ECE joint or secondary appointment qualifies, including courtesy appointments. Retain an explicit courtesy designation; use joint_secondary when the official source does not establish the regular-versus-courtesy subtype. The missing subtype alone does not block an affiliation count. Count each person once per institution without inferring FTE.
publication_membership_rule: ECE-venue authorship is discovery evidence only. CS-only professors do not enter this faculty roster.
temporal_scope: Latest accepted roster observation, including announced incoming appointments and a separate incoming subtotal. Publication-year filters do not change faculty counts. Historical school rosters are deferred.
change_authority: User approved the ECE-affiliated faculty metric, including courtesy appointments. Prior regular/in-residence counts retain their original policy and require broader-source coverage review before publication under v4.
ranking_effect: None. Existing institution-level publication credit and scoring are unchanged.
public_count_gate: All candidate entries adjudicated, full official source enumeration checked, no unresolved inclusion decisions, evidence references valid, and independent review reconciled.
count_basis: Official university regular, in-residence, courtesy and joint/secondary EE/ECE professorial appointments, including announced incoming appointments; count each person once per school, not FTE.

category_rules.courtesy: Explicit university EE/ECE professorial appointment by courtesy; a generic affiliation or lab membership is insufficient.
category_rules.joint_secondary: Official EE/ECE professorial joint/secondary appointment; regular-versus-courtesy subtype unspecified. Do not use for a generic affiliate, adjunct, research-only or teaching/practice appointment.
